reason: This looks like an optional compensation/AC-shaping capacitor (it connects the output node to an internal node that is otherwise only resistively referenced). Removing it typically preserves DC operating point and basic differential amplification, but changes stability/bandwidth and transient response.
impact_estimate: Low for DC functionality; Medium for AC stability/phase margin and transient settling (may increase peaking or risk oscillation depending on load and loop gain).

reason: This is a shunt load/bleeder on the output; the amplifier output stage already provides a DC path and biasing through the transistor network. Removing R3 usually leaves the amplifier functional but changes output loading, output swing, and possibly the DC output level if it was used to define a default load condition.
impact_estimate: Low-to-Medium: improves gain/lightens load, but may alter output bias point and make the output more sensitive to leakage/load conditions.
